inShort: A dinks, then speeds up at B's paddle-side hip. B slides toward that side, so the ball ends up on the backhand, and punches it back.
rules: A and B stand at the kitchen line, A on the left half, B on the right half (left-handers: mirror it).
A dinks, then speeds up at B's right hip.
B slides to the right, weight onto the right foot, and takes the ball with the backhand in front of the body.
Punch, then snap: arm first, wrist last, about 80 % arm. No take-back.
Keep the paddle tip up, so the face doesn't open and the ball doesn't sail.
Straight back to the start position. 10 balls, then swap roles.
tooEasy: A plays at full pace and picks the moment of the speed-up freely.
tooHard: A calls "now" before the speed-up and plays at half pace.
goodLooksLike: B's feet move before the paddle, the tip stays up, and the ball goes down at A's feet.
